dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: It's my cafe! And let me tell you, this will become the resort's absolute best cafe in the near future. What do you think? Looks wonderful, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Aside from the cafe's decor, name, equipment, and all that other nonsense, I've already got everything else covered! We're ready for anything!
